entry.title: Far From Home
entry.summary:
Author: nathandun

Rating: MatureLanguage: EnglishWords: 15,878Chapters: 9/?Kudos: 32

Summary: Evan Buckley's sudden disappearance turns into a desperate race against the clock when Eddie Diaz discovers that his partner has been taken by Bonnie—a deeply disturbed woman trapped in the labyrinth of her own mind and grief for a deceased son. For Bonnie, reality and lies blur together, and she will do whatever it takes to keep Buck captive, firmly believing he is her Derek. Determined to bring his best friend back, Eddie takes on a dangerous cover and sets off on a relentless hunt, crossing three state lines into the arid desert between Oklahoma and New Mexico. Standing before the door of that isolated cabin, he will need every ounce of his composure to confront the psychosis of a woman who has nothing left to lose. But when the dust settles and the rescue is finally complete, returning to Los Angeles brings a long-forgotten sense of calm. Between the walls of a hospital room and the relief of survival, Eddie faces the fragility of their lives as firefighters and realizes he cannot—and will not—wait for a third time to admit that Buck is, and always has been, his home. An intense story about survival, the weight of time, and the realization that home isn't always a place, but a person.

Eddie would never tell you this himself, but it needs to be said because he’s suffering far too much because of you. You’ve taken over his life to the point where he barely has one anymore.
